blocks.text: i) Primary amines halogenoalkanes aur ammonia ke nucleophilic substitution reaction se banai ja sakti hain. Ethanol mein ghuli hui ammonia excess (zyada) mein aur pressure par li jati hai, taa ke secondary amines ya products ka mixture na bane.
Agar NH₃ zyada ho to major (sab se zyada banne wala) product primary amine hota hai, aur agar halogenoalkane zyada ho to tertiary amine major product hota hai.

blocks.alt: CH3-CH2-Br (bromoethane) + NH3 (excess), arrow ke oopar ethanol aur neeche High pressure, se CH3-CH2-NH2 (ethanamine) + HBr.
blocks.caption: Bromoethane aur excess (zyada) ammonia se ethanamine (kitab ke page 120 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: ii) Alkanenitriles ko reduce karne (hydrogen dene) se primary amines banti hain. Maslan propanenitrile ko H₂/Ni ya LiAlH₄ se reduce kar ke propan-1-amine banti hai.

blocks.alt: CH3-CH2-C triple bond N (propanenitrile) + 4[H], arrow ke oopar LiAlH4, se CH3-CH2-CH2-NH2 (propan-1-amine).
blocks.caption: Propanenitrile ki reduction se propan-1-amine (kitab ke page 120 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: iii) Nitroalkanes ko LiAlH₄ ki presence (maujoodgi) mein reduce karne se primary amines banti hain.

blocks.alt: CH3-CH2-NO2 (nitroethane) + 3H2, arrow ke oopar LiAlH4, se CH3-CH2-NH2 (ethanamine) + 2H2O.
blocks.caption: Nitroethane ki reduction se ethanamine (kitab ke page 120 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: iv) Alkanamides ko LiAlH₄ se reduce karne par primary amines good yield (achhi miqdar) mein milti hain, kyunke is reaction mein koi by-product (saath mein banne wala faltu product) nahi banta.

blocks.alt: CH3-C(=O)-NH2 (ethanamide) + 4[H], arrow ke oopar LiAlH4 aur neeche H2O/H+, se CH3-CH2-NH2 (ethanamine) + H2O.
blocks.caption: Ethanamide ki reduction se ethanamine (kitab ke page 121 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: v) Primary alkanamine Hofmann reaction se bhi banai ja sakti hai.

blocks.alt: Do lines mein Hofmann reaction: CH3-C(=O)-NH2 + Br2 + 4NaOH se CH3-NH2 + 2NaBr + Na2CO3 + 2H2O.
blocks.caption: Ethanamide ka Hofmann reaction (kitab ke page 121 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Is reaction se jo amine milti hai us mein shuru wali amide se aik carbon kam hota hai (yahan ethanamide ke 2 carbon se methanamine ka 1 carbon).

i) Primary amines ki alkylation (alkyl group lagana) se secondary amines banti hain. Jab halogenoalkane ethanol ki presence mein pressure par primary amine se react karta hai to secondary amine banti hai.

blocks.alt: CH3-CH2-Br (bromoethane) + CH3-NH2, arrow ke oopar ethanol, se CH3-CH2-NH-CH3 (N-methylethanamine) + HBr.
blocks.caption: Bromoethane se methanamine ki alkylation (kitab ke page 121 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: ii) N-substituted amides ko reduce karne se bhi secondary amines banti hain.

blocks.alt: CH3-C(=O)-NH-CH3 (N-methylethanamide) + 2H2, arrow ke oopar Ni/Pt, se CH3-CH2-NH-CH3 (N-methylethanamine) + H2O.
blocks.caption: N-methylethanamide ki reduction se N-methylethanamine (kitab ke page 121 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne N-methylethanamide ki reduction ‘+ H₂’ (Ni/Pt) se likhi aur paani nahi dikhaya; yeh balanced nahi. C=O ka oxygen paani (H₂O) ban kar nikalta hai, is liye do H₂ molecules chahiye: CH₃CONHCH₃ + 2H₂ → CH₃CH₂NHCH₃ + H₂O, jaisa drawing mein hai.

i. Phenyl amine chlorobenzene ki ammonolysis se banti hai. Ammonolysis woh reaction hai jis mein ammonia ka molecule toot kar kisi doosre compound se react karta hai. Yeh reaction Cu₂O ki presence mein 250 °C aur 50 atm par hota hai.

blocks.alt: Chlorobenzene (Cl wali benzene ring) + 2NH3, arrow ke oopar Cu2O aur neeche 250 °C, 50 atm, se phenylamine (NH2 wali ring) + NH4Cl.
blocks.caption: Chlorobenzene ki ammonolysis se phenylamine (kitab ke page 121 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: iii. Nitrobenzene ko reduce karne se bhi phenyl amine banti hai; reducing agent Sn aur concentrated HCl hai. (Kitab is list mein ii chhor kar i ke baad iii likhti hai.)

blocks.alt: Nitrobenzene (NO2 wali ring) + 6[H], arrow ke oopar Sn + concentrated (garha) HCl, se phenyl amine (aniline) (NH2 wali ring) + 2H2O.
blocks.caption: Nitrobenzene ki reduction se phenyl amine (kitab ke page 122 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: iv. Phenyl amine Hofmann reaction se bhi banti hai: benzamide, Br₂ aur NaOH se.

blocks.alt: Do lines mein Hofmann reaction: benzamide (C(=O)-NH2 wali ring) + Br2 + 4NaOH se phenylamine (NH2 wali ring) + 2NaBr + Na2CO3 + 2H2O.
blocks.caption: Benzamide ka Hofmann reaction (kitab ke page 122 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.prompt: a) Chocolate ka “feel good factor” 2-phenylethanamine, C₆H₅CH₂CH₂NH₂, hai. Ise chloromethylbenzene, C₆H₅CH₂Cl, se banane ka tareeqa batayein.
blocks.explanation: C₆H₅CH₂Cl ko ethanol mein KCN ke saath reflux par garam kar ke C₆H₅CH₂CN banayein (chain mein aik carbon barh jata hai). Phir nitrile ko LiAlH₄ (ya H₂/Ni) se reduce karein: C₆H₅CH₂CN + 4[H] → C₆H₅CH₂CH₂NH₂.

blocks.prompt: b) Kaun sa nitro compound, nitrile aur amide reduce ho kar (i) primary amine CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH₂–NH₂ aur (ii) secondary amine CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–CH₂–NH–CH₃ dete hain?
blocks.explanation: (i) Nitro compound (CH₃)₂CHCH₂NO₂; nitrile (CH₃)₂CHCN; amide (CH₃)₂CHCONH₂. (ii) Nitro compounds aur nitriles reduce ho kar sirf primary amines dete hain, is liye yahan sirf amide kaam karti hai: CH₃CH₂CH₂CONHCH₃ (N-methylbutanamide).

items: Primary amines: RX + zyada NH₃; nitriles, nitro compounds ya amides ki reduction; Hofmann reaction (aik carbon kam).
Secondary amines: RX + primary amine; N-substituted amides ki reduction.
Phenyl amine: chlorobenzene + NH₃ (Cu₂O), nitrobenzene ki reduction (Sn/HCl), ya benzamide ka Hofmann reaction.
